## Goal (user story)

As a developer/QA, I want a head-to-head Monte Carlo harness for competitive mode (extending MainStreetMonteCarlo) that runs ≥200 seeds and produces win/score distributions plus per-player metrics, so balance between player and AI can be measured across seeded runs.

## Context

`MainStreetMonteCarlo` is single-player only (`runMonteCarlo` / `runAllCombinations` with one strategy × one difficulty per run). Competitive mode needs head-to-head metrics: both players' win/score distributions plus per-player diagnostics. Architecture is N-player-ready (PlayerRecord[] indexed by owner), but the harness validates the head-to-head (human vs 1 AI) path initially; N>2 extension is a future parameterisation.

## Scope

- Head-to-head harness extending `MainStreetMonteCarlo` (new entry point or flag): both players act per shared-day, same seed → deterministic head-to-head run.
- ≥200 seeds; outputs win/score distributions plus per-player metrics (wins per owner, average score per owner, draw/early-end handling).
- Single-player AI tests (`ai-strategy.test.ts`, balance guardrails) still pass unchanged.

## Out of scope

- AI strategy itself (sibling).
- Per-owner income routing (sibling).
- Rendering / scene (AC5 child).
- Endless continuation (deferred).
- N>2 Monte Carlo — harness is N-player-extensible (numOpponents param) but AC4 validates head-to-head; broader N is a follow-up.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1:** Head-to-head harness runs ≥200 seeds with deterministic head-to-head execution (same seed → same per-owner outcome) and produces win/score distributions (win rate per owner, median/average score per owner).
- [ ] **AC2:** Per-player metrics include at least wins, average score, and loss-reason distribution per owner plus a deterministic summary (draw/early-end handling documented).
- [ ] **AC3:** Extension of `MainStreetMonteCarlo` (not a replacement); existing `runMonteCarlo` / `runAllCombinations` and `monte-carlo-balance.test.ts` still pass.
- [ ] **AC4:** Validated against the adapted competitive AI strategy (CG-0MT5X3N79002S038).

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMonteCarlo.ts` — Competitive head-to-head harness extension (win/score distributions, per-player metrics).
- `tests/main-street/competitive-monte-carlo.test.ts` — Dedicated competitive Monte Carlo tests (determinism, distributions, guardrails).

## Related Work

- Parent: CG-0MT5X3GMA007EG30
- Depends on: competitive state model + phase machine + income routing + AI strategy (CG-0MT5X3N79002S038)
- Architecture: N-player-ready state/phase; harness parametrises head-to-head initially

## Goal (user story)

As a player, I want the shared street rendered with owner-coloured slots, shared-market phase alternation, and SFX/animations (per AGENTS.md §8), so competitive ownership is visually and audibly unambiguous.

## Context

AC5 of the parent epic is engine-only: no game-selector entry, no competitive scene, no competitive UI chrome. This planning-created child (per AC5 “deferred to a planning child” and producer Q2 “planning”) captures the deferred rendering scope for the next milestone. Worker must use core-engine animation helpers with `soundManager` + `sfx` (AGENTS.md §8: every animated action needs sound + animation; SFX keys via `COMMON_SFX_KEYS`, no literals).

## Scope

- Competitive scene (Phaser scene) with SLL layout.
- Owner-coloured street: each placed business's street slot tinted by owner (e.g. player = blue, AI = red) so the shared grid's ownership is immediately readable.
- Shared-market phase alternation: alternate MarketPhases within a shared day with visible whose-turn affordance.
- SFX/animations for all competitive actions (deal/flip/place/discard/illegal) via helpers + `SoundManager`, respecting reduced-motion and mute.
- Turn alternation SFX/animation sequencing so AI actions are visible (delayed AI turn like Coloretto precedent).

## Out of scope

- Engine state/phase/income/AI/Monte Carlo (parent epic siblings).
- Game-selector entry — include only when the scene is ready for play (within this child).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1:** Competitive scene renders the shared street with per-slot owner colour (player vs AI unambiguously distinct); SLL layout used (no hardcoded pixel positions).
- [ ] **AC2:** Shared-market phase alternation is visible (whose turn) and input is gated to the active player; AI turn is animated with a brief delay.
- [ ] **AC3:** Every competitive action that uses a core-engine animation helper is wired with SFX (via helper `soundManager`/`sfx` params or `GameEventEmitter`/`SoundManager`); SFX keys follow `COMMON_SFX_KEYS` convention; reduced-motion and mute respected.
- [ ] **AC4:** Build + unit tests pass; smoke browser coverage for the scene.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetCompetitiveScene.ts` — Competitive scene (owner-coloured street, phase alternation, SFX).
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetCompetitiveRenderer.ts` — Owner-colour helpers (tinting by ownerId).
- `src/core-engine/SoundManager.ts` — `COMMON_SFX_KEYS` source of truth for SFX keys.
- `tests/main-street/competitive-scene.browser.test.ts` — Smoke/browser coverage.

## Related Work

- Parent: CG-0MT5X3GMA007EG30 — Main Street competitive mode (engine-only; rendering deferred here per AC5)
- Siblings: state, phase, income/events, AI strategy, Monte Carlo (engine foundation this child renders)
- AGENTS.md §8 — Every action with animation must have SFX

# Intake Brief — Implement IT Specialist and Delivery Driver cost-reduction effects (MS-0MUMCVH3N007KT1M)

The `staff-it` (IT Specialist) and `staff-delivery` (Delivery Driver) descriptions advertise coin-cost reductions that no engine path applies. They were rescaled to the ×100 integer economy in `CG-0MTKMGL66004I0PC` but deliberately left unimplemented there (Q4 decision), because their wording named a per-business target that has no implementing mechanic. This item decides the intended scope (street-wide, confirmed by the producer) and implements both effects end-to-end.

## Problem statement

The two cards promise a discount the engine never applies, so the printed ability is not the ability the player gets. This item removes that text/data gap by backing each description with a data column and an engine consumer, and by extending the staff cost-text regression guard so the gap cannot silently return.

## Users

- **Main Street player** — reads a staff card's printed ability and expects the advertised reduction to apply where the engine charges the cost.
- **Game designer / balancer** — needs every staff cost-reduction description backed by a `card-data.csv` data column so economy tuning is trustworthy.
- **Developer / QA** — needs the regression guard to fail loudly if a staff cost-reduction description is not backed by data.

### User stories

- As a player, when I employ the IT Specialist I pay 100 less when I refresh the market.
- As a player, when I employ the Delivery Driver I pay 50 less when I buy a business card.
- As a designer, every staff cost-reduction description is backed by a data column and an engine consumer.
- As a developer, the guard fails with the offending card id if a description and its data column drift apart.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **IT Specialist refresh discount is implemented and data-backed.** `src/card-data.csv` sets `refreshCostDiscount = 100` for `staff-it` and its description reads street-wide (e.g. "Modernizes operations. Reduces market refresh cost by 100."). With a hired IT Specialist, `refreshMarketCost(state)` equals `REFRESH_MARKET_COST - 100`; with an IT Specialist **and** an Accountant it equals `- 200`; the result is floored at 0. Verified by unit tests.
2. **Delivery Driver purchase discount is implemented and data-backed.** A new `purchaseCostDiscount` staff field and `card-data.csv` column carry `50` for `staff-delivery`; the parser populates it onto `StaffCard`; its description reads street-wide (e.g. "Handles the logistics. Reduces business card purchase cost by 50."). While a Delivery Driver is hired, the coin cost of acquiring/placing a business or community-space card is reduced by 50 through **all** acquisition paths — `purchaseBusiness` (click, listed cost), `buyAndPlaceBusiness` (drag: discount the base cost **then** apply the +50% premium), and `playBusinessFromHand` (deferred listed payment, including the same-week composite premium) — while `moveToHand` (0 coins) is unaffected. Effective cost is floored at 0; multiple `purchaseCostDiscount` staff stack additively. Verified by unit tests.
3. **Regression guard extended.** `tests/main-street/staff-cost-text-data-consistency.test.ts` registers `staff-it` with `column: 'refreshCostDiscount'` and `staff-delivery` with `column: 'purchaseCostDiscount'` (both non-null, `UNIMPLEMENTED_NOTE` removed), and the description-amount == data-column assertions pass.
4. **New column is schema-coordinated (cross-repo).** The `purchaseCostDiscount` column is added to core `src/balance-cards/csv.ts` (`CsvRow`, `CSV_COLUMNS`, `NUMERIC_COLUMNS`), to the `card-data.csv` header (immediately after `upgradeCostDiscount`, before `art_notes`), to the staff parser, and the `tce-main-street` `./core` submodule pin is bumped; `balance-cards-csv-pipeline.test.ts` column-count/order assertions are updated and pass.
5. **AI affordability parity.** `MainStreetAiStrategy` uses the effective (discounted) business-purchase cost for its affordability/value scoring, so AI play is not disadvantaged. Verified by a unit test.
6. **Documentation updated.** `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` (ability/description/rationale cells) removes the "description-only — effect not implemented (gap)" notes and reflects the implemented mechanics; `docs/main-street/specialization-skills.md` records the implemented cost-reduction mechanics. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
7. **Determinism preserved.** No new RNG consumption; headless/AI parity and seeded determinism are unchanged. Verified by the existing determinism tests plus any new tests.
8. **Tests, build and full suite green.** New/updated unit tests pass, `npm run build` succeeds, and the full project test suite passes with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Source of truth is `card-data.csv`.** Do not hand-rebalance unrelated values.
- **Scoping is street-wide (confirmed).** `refreshCostDiscount` is already summed street-wide by `refreshMarketCost`; `purchaseCostDiscount` is summed street-wide across hired staff (`state.staffCards`), matching `refreshCostDiscount` and the Negotiator skill. Do not silently make either effect per-business.
- **Pricing precedence.** For the discounted +50% buy-and-place composite, discount the listed base cost first, then apply the premium (the rule established by `CG-0MTKMGL66004I0PC`).
- **CSV schema addition is cross-repo.** A new column requires a core (`Tableau-Card-Engine`) `src/balance-cards/csv.ts` change plus a `tce-main-street` `./core` submodule pin bump, mirroring the `upgradeCostDiscount` precedent (`MS-0MULW540X009EP9A`).
- **No new RNG consumption; determinism and headless/AI parity preserved.**
- **Minimal churn** — touch only the staff/economy paths in scope.

### Out of scope

- Rebalancing any other coin/reputation value.
- Implementing the other nominal applicant perks (Barista, Bookkeeper, Customer Service Rep, Security Guard, etc.) — their live effects come from the random specialization-skill system (`CG-0MT1CIWSD003VBPK`).
- Changing the base `REFRESH_MARKET_COST` or introducing escalating re-roll pricing (tracked separately in `MS-0MTR6ZRF5007PWNZ`).

## Existing state

- `staff-it` (`src/card-data.csv`): `cost=800`, `tier=4`, `ongoingCost=100`, `allowedBusinessTypes=Commerce|Entertainment|Service`, description "Modernizes operations. Reduces this business refresh cost by 100." — **no** `refreshCostDiscount` value.
- `staff-delivery` (`src/card-data.csv`): `cost=300`, `tier=2`, `ongoingCost=50`, `allowedBusinessTypes=Food|Commerce`, description "Handles the logistics. Reduces business card purchase cost by 50 for this business." — no matching data column exists.
- `refreshMarketCost(state)` (`src/MainStreetMarketRefill.ts`) is a single global re-roll of the one-row market (`REFRESH_MARKET_COST = 500`); it sums every hired staff card's `refreshCostDiscount` (street-wide) plus the Negotiator skill (`skill-negotiator`, −100) and clamps at 0. There is **no per-business refresh**.
- `purchaseBusiness` (click, listed cost), `buyAndPlaceBusiness` (drag, `Math.ceil(cost * 1.5 * 2) / 2`), and `playBusinessFromHand` (deferred listed cost, optional premium) charge `card.cost` directly; there is no purchase-cost-discount field or path. `moveToHand` costs 0 coins.
- `computeUpgradeCostDiscount(state, slotIndex)` (`src/MainStreetStaffBuffs.ts`) is the established per-business discount helper (Financial Advisor `upgradeCostDiscount`), applied in the upgrade acquisition paths.
- `tests/main-street/staff-cost-text-data-consistency.test.ts` currently registers both cards with `column: null` and `UNIMPLEMENTED_NOTE`.
- `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` marks both cards "description-only — effect not implemented (gap)".

## Desired change

- Set `refreshCostDiscount = 100` on `staff-it` in `card-data.csv`; reword its description to street-wide wording. No engine change is required — `refreshMarketCost` already consumes the column.
- Add a `purchaseCostDiscount` staff field, `card-data.csv` column and parser support; set `50` on `staff-delivery`; reword its description to street-wide wording.
- Add a pure `computePurchaseCostDiscount(state)` helper in `src/MainStreetStaffBuffs.ts` (street-wide sum over `state.staffCards`, clamped at 0) and apply the effective cost in `canPurchaseBusiness`/`purchaseBusiness`, `buyAndPlaceBusiness`, and `playBusinessFromHand` (discount the base cost before any premium).
- Update `MainStreetAiStrategy` to score/afford business purchases using the discounted cost.
- Add/extend unit tests for both effects (click, drag, deferred play-from-hand, stacking, clamp, discount-then-premium, AI parity), and extend the regression guard to non-null column contracts for both cards.
- Coordinate the new column across the game CSV and core balance-cards schema; bump the `./core` pin.
- Update `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` and `docs/main-street/specialization-skills.md`.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/card-data.csv` — `staff-it` gains `refreshCostDiscount=100`; `staff-delivery` gains `purchaseCostDiscount=50`; both descriptions reworded street-wide.
- `src/MainStreetCardsTypes.ts` — add `readonly purchaseCostDiscount?: number` to `StaffCard`.
- `src/MainStreetCardsTemplates.ts` — parse the `purchaseCostDiscount` staff column into templates.
- `src/MainStreetStaffBuffs.ts` — add pure `computePurchaseCostDiscount(state)` (mirrors `refreshCostDiscount` aggregation/floor semantics).
- `src/MainStreetMarketRefill.ts` — `refreshMarketCost` (no logic change expected for the IT Specialist).
- `src/MainStreetMarketPurchase.ts` — apply the purchase discount in `canPurchaseBusiness` / `purchaseBusiness`.
- `src/MainStreetMarketHand.ts` — apply the discount in `playBusinessFromHand` (base before premium).
- `src/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts` — apply the discount in `buyAndPlaceBusiness` (base before premium).
- `src/MainStreetAiStrategy.ts` — use the effective (discounted) business-purchase cost for affordability/value scoring.
- `core/src/balance-cards/csv.ts` — add `purchaseCostDiscount` to `CsvRow` / `CSV_COLUMNS` / `NUMERIC_COLUMNS` (core repo), then bump the `./core` pin.
- `tests/main-street/staff-cost-text-data-consistency.test.ts` — non-null `column` contracts for both cards; drop `UNIMPLEMENTED_NOTE`.
- `tests/main-street/` — new/updated tests for both effects (click + drag + deferred play-from-hand, stacking, clamp, discount-then-premium, AI parity).
- `tests/main-street/balance-cards-csv-pipeline.test.ts` — update column-count/order assertions.
- `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` — update the staff ability/description/rationale cells and remove the "gap" notes.
- `docs/main-street/specialization-skills.md` — note the implemented cost-reduction mechanics.

## Related work

- **CG-0MTKMGL66004I0PC** (core, in_review) — Staff effects adjusted for the ×100 coin values; Q4 deferred IT Specialist / Delivery Driver implementation and corrected their text only. This item is the explicit follow-up.
- **MS-0MULW540X009EP9A** (completed) — CSV schema: add `upgradeCostDiscount` column; the cross-repo precedent for adding a staff discount column.
- **MS-0MULWC8CR0011NOX** (completed) — Financial Advisor end-to-end: per-business discount helper and all upgrade acquisition paths.
- **MS-0MULWEEE8007J2TB** (completed) — Accountant `refreshCostDiscount` fixed to ×100; the refresh-discount precedent.
- **MS-0MULWBSF9000Z64Z** (completed) — staff description text ×100 consistency; created the guard this item extends.
- **MS-0MTR6ZRF5007PWNZ** (open) — "Reroll to cost more": changes `refreshMarketCost` semantics (escalating base) and interacts with the IT Specialist refresh discount. Coordinate if both land together.
- **MS-0MTQ7S5EJ008MWD0** (in-progress) — sibling staff-ability implementation touching the same CSV, catalog and guard; sequence to avoid merge conflicts.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk: cross-repo schema desynchronisation** if the new column is added without the core `csv.ts` + submodule pin update. Mitigation: one coordinated change, per `MS-0MULW540X009EP9A`.
- **Risk: scoping leak / bypass.** If the purchase discount is applied only to click+drag, a player could bypass it by moving a card to hand and playing it later. Mitigation: apply it consistently across `purchaseBusiness`, `buyAndPlaceBusiness` and `playBusinessFromHand`; assert the scope boundary in tests.
- **Risk: drag-premium ordering** changes the price. Mitigation: discount the base cost, then apply the premium, and assert in tests.
- **Risk: AI ignores the discount.** Mitigation: update `MainStreetAiStrategy` affordability/value to use the effective cost.
- **Risk: scope creep.** Keep to these two cards only.
- **Risk: ordering conflict with `MS-0MTR6ZRF5007PWNZ`** (escalating re-roll). Mitigation: coordinate sequencing; the IT discount applies to whatever the escalated base cost is.
- **Assumption:** multiple `purchaseCostDiscount` staff stack additively and clamp at 0, mirroring `refreshCostDiscount` / `upgradeCostDiscount`. (Confirmed street-wide.)
- **Assumption:** the description amounts (100 / 50) are correct on the ×100 scale and are not rebalanced here.
- **Assumption:** `playBusinessFromHand` is included in the Delivery Driver scope (deferred payment for a business card is economically a purchase); `moveToHand` costs 0 coins and is excluded. This closes the move-to-hand bypass. Documented for the implementer; the producer may narrow it if desired.

## Design decisions (confirmed)

- **IT Specialist — street-wide refresh discount (option a).** Reuse `refreshCostDiscount = 100` on `staff-it`; reword the description to remove "this business". No new engine surface.
- **Delivery Driver — street-wide purchase discount (option a).** Add `purchaseCostDiscount = 50`, applied street-wide to business/community-space purchases (click + drag, base-then-premium, plus deferred play-from-hand for consistency); reword the description.
- **Description/catalog/guard/schema (option a).** Reword both descriptions to street-wide, back both with data columns, and coordinate the new column across game + core.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q1 (IT Specialist, prior session): "Reuse `refreshCostDiscount = 100` on `staff-it` (street-wide; stacks with Accountant/Negotiator) and reword, or introduce a new per-business refresh mechanic?" — **Answer (producer, interactive): "(1) A — reuse `refreshCostDiscount = 100`, street-wide."** Source: interactive reply in this session. Research: `src/MainStreetMarketRefill.ts` `refreshMarketCost` sums `refreshCostDiscount` street-wide; `src/MainStreetStaffBuffs.ts` has `computeRefreshCostDiscount` (Negotiator −100); `staff-accountant` already uses `refreshCostDiscount=100`; parent `CG-0MTKMGL66004I0PC` Q4.
- Q2 (Delivery Driver, prior session): "Add `purchaseCostDiscount = 50` applied street-wide to business/community-space purchases (click + drag, base-then-premium) and reword, or scope to adjacency, or leave unimplemented?" — **Answer (producer, interactive): "(2) a — add `purchaseCostDiscount = 50`, street-wide, click + drag, base-then-premium."** Source: interactive reply. Research: no `purchaseCostDiscount` reference exists in `src/` or `tests/`; `purchaseBusiness`/`buyAndPlaceBusiness`/`playBusinessFromHand` charge `card.cost` directly; parent `CG-0MTKMGL66004I0PC` Q4.
- Q3 (description/catalog/guard/schema, prior session): "Reword to street-wide, back both descriptions with columns, and coordinate the new column across game + core?" — **Answer (producer, interactive): "(3) a — reword to street-wide, back both descriptions with data columns, coordinate the new column across game + core."** Source: interactive reply. Research: the guard currently registers both cards with `column: null` + `UNIMPLEMENTED_NOTE`; adding a CSV column requires core `src/balance-cards/csv.ts` + `./core` pin coordination (precedent `MS-0MULW540X009EP9A`).
- Prior context (parent, `CG-0MTKMGL66004I0PC` Q4): IT Specialist and Delivery Driver were deferred from the ×100 migration because their per-business target had no implementing mechanic; their descriptions were rescaled but their effects left unimplemented. This item closes that gap under the street-wide decisions above.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **MS-0MUBVL4H80061B1E** – Assign dedicated card art to every Main Street card (1024×1024 source; eliminate generic Fallback art) (open)
- **MS-0MTSAWSME004BH6S** – Add images for all cards (open)
- **MS-0MUMP97LQ006PP1D** – Storyline journal overlay & choice clarity (blocked)

### Repository file matches
- `core/docs/DEVELOPER.md` — matched: ability, acceptance, add, added, adding (+310 more)
- `core/AGENTS.md` — matched: ability, acceptance, add, added, adding (+252 more)
- `docs/main-street/prd-milestone-2.md` — matched: ability, acceptance, add, added, adding (+229 more)

# Goal

Apply the six test-suite clean-up recommendations that were raised against the core repo's `tests/main-street/` suite (audit report `docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` in Tableau-Card-Engine, epic CG-0MTCOPO8U001UW2Y) and are now owned by the `tce-main-street` sibling repo after the multi-repo split.

# Why

The core audit (2026-09-20) classified these files `remove`/`clean-up` and created core child work items for them. The multi-repo split (CG-0MUJ166VM006ULRJ) moved the files here, so the recommendations transfer to this repo.

# Recommendations to apply (from the core report §§R1, C2–C5, C7)

1. **R1 — remove `tests/main-street/MainStreetApplicant.test.ts`.** Placeholder/tautological: 30 `expect(true).toBe(true)` behind a `require()` probe that throws `Cannot find module` under Vitest ESM, so zero real assertions execute. Re-implement the applicant specification with static ESM imports.
2. **C2 — `tests/main-street/staff-market-row-ui.test.ts`:** delete the `AC6: no orphaned staffCardMarket references` source-grep block; keep the behavioural tests.
3. **C3 — `tests/main-street/sold-card-tooltip.test.ts`:** replace the `readFileSync` of `MainStreetRenderer*` with a behavioural assertion on the tooltip builder output.
4. **C4 — `tests/main-street/market-card-cheat.test.ts`:** replace the tree-shake source-grep with a behavioural check that the cheat is absent from the production build/registration path.
5. **C5 — `tests/main-street/help-panel-content.test.ts`:** extract the help/rules content to a Phaser-free module imported by both the scene and the test (the test currently mirrors a private copy).
6. **C7 — `tests/main-street/LegalityResult.test.ts`:** delete the `void`-ed compile-time helpers and literal-shape assertions; keep the genuine `legalAction()`/`illegalAction()` behavioural tests.

# Acceptance criteria

- Each of the six anti-pattern blocks above is removed or converted to a behavioural assertion as described.
- `npm test -- --project unit` is green after the changes.
- No remaining `expect(true).toBe(true)`, no `readFileSync` of `.ts` source, and no source-text sweeps in the six files (or the files are removed).
- `npm run build` passes.

# Cross-repo provenance

Transferred from Tableau-Card-Engine child items CG-0MUA14BRW008HXMX, CG-0MUA14DQR009U8CE, CG-0MUA14EEB004QFDJ, CG-0MUA14F1B005LRNR, CG-0MUA14FNQ008FXHJ, CG-0MUA14GXJ009C4W8. Evidence: `docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` §§R1, C2–C5, C7.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items

# Problem

The in-game Main Street Help/Rules panel has drifted from its PRD definition (PRD milestone 5 §6):

- PRD lists 6 required sections; production renders 7 (an extra "Staff & Specialization Skills" section was added post-PRD).
- PRD asks for "<= 8 lines per section where possible"; production "How to Play" is 11 author lines and "Turn Flow" is 13.

# Impact

`tests/main-street/help-panel-content.test.ts` now asserts against the real production content (test-review C5, MS-0MUMO3BDE000QDXJ) and encodes documented line ceilings (11/13) for those two sections so the suite stays green. The PRD's <= 8-line target is not enforced for them.

# Options

1. Trim the help copy back to <= 8 lines per section (content change; may lose mechanics detail).
2. Update PRD milestone 5 §6 to reflect the 7-section layout and relaxed line budget (docs change).
3. Leave as-is and keep the documented ceilings.

# Provenance
